title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - CompliantCredential
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/CompliantCredential. Snapshot of a credential deemed compliant by a compliance engine. This uses a unique identifier and a hash to ensure the credential will not be modified in a near future.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CompliantCredential'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

credentialType.description: Property. Type of the compliant credential.

digestSRI.description: Property. Subresource Integrity hash of the verifiable credential, ensuring it has not been modified (SriString).
